description: This file defines a test factory class 'DbTestAppFactory' for integration testing of a .NET web application backend. The class manages provisioning of an in-memory or containerized PostgreSQL database, applies database migrations, and provides an authenticated HTTP client for tests. It encapsulates logic to select between managed Postgres via environment variable ('DATABASE_URL') or a Docker container if Docker is available. Includes methods for database provisioning, applying migrations, and setting up test authentication tokens. Implements xUnit lifecycle interface for async initialization and disposal.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A specialized WebApplicationFactory for integration tests that require a database backend. Manages provisioning, migration, and test authentication setup for tests involving the backend API.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Returns a HttpClient with Authorization header and correlation ID set for test scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Configures the test web host with environment, connection string, and dependency injection adjustments.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs setup: provisions database backend, applies migrations, and retrieves auth token.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up the test database container if used.
